description: A template literal holding `;` and a newline is one string, not two statements. Written in all four handler positions — top level (#top), an engine state-child (#eng), a `<match>` arm (#mat) and an `<each>` row (.row); each click appends position-tagged tokens to `log`, so the final value proves every statement ran, once, in source order, at every position. S437 round 3 (the handler statement list is PARSED by the function-body statement parser, not split as text).
rationale: §5.2.3: "The statement list is logic context — the same statement grammar as a function body (§7.3): statements are separated by `;` or by a newline, and assignments, calls, `const`/`let` declarations, and `if`/loop statements are all legal. The block MAY span any number of lines." and "No statement of the block SHALL be dropped, whatever its kind or position".
